ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Newgen Software Technologies Limited (FY25-26)**  Newgen Software Technologies Limited demonstrated solid financial performance for FY25-26, reporting ₹15,744 million in consolidated revenue (6% Y-o-Y growth) with a healthy 21.2% adjusted PAT margin and robust operating cash flows, significantly bolstered by 62% annuity revenue. Strategic advancements include acquiring 47 new customers and progressing AI innovations, with the company proposing a Rs. 6/- per share final dividend. All auditor reports presented at the 34th AGM were clean, and no material red flags were identified.
